issues.on_page: Public Works 631,752 (Total Nonmajor) = COVID American Rescue Plan Fund 573,636 + Noxious Weed Fund 58,116 (p14)
issues.issue: The Total Nonmajor Public Works line includes 58,116 of Noxious Weed Fund spending. Under the 2026-11-04 rule that spending is natural resources/conservation. The line is a mixed Total-column line, so leaving it as one item is defensible, but 58,116 of noxious weed spending is now counted as streets/highways.
The label joins the section heading to the printed row label. The same applies to disbursements[6] 'Debt Service: Interest and Fiscal Charges'. Amounts are correct.
